mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 90 days.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts and industrial production indicates broad-based economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as growth expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline by at least 1.0% from prior month values.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high GDP growth (annualized rate > 2.5%), profit-taking and rising rate expectations produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where annualized GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 1.5 points signals rapid economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as manufacturing weakness spreads.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1.5 points in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (annualized CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals an overheating economy, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 2.5% and UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior three months signals robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 90 days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls exceeding 50,000 jobs signals labor market weakness, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines by more than 50,000 jobs in a single month.
